title: Completing a block quadratic form
audience: The reader expands real quadratic forms and solves an invertible triangular change of variables. Symmetric positivity is refreshed; the cross-term-eliminating variable and Schur complement are constructed here.
reader_goals: Recover the complete strict-positivity criterion from a local quadratic-form problem.
Execute the cancellation, both implications and fixed-y minimization, then identify failure under mere invertibility.
prerequisites: Real matrix multiplication and transpose; quadratic-form positivity; inverse of an invertible matrix.
